name: OpenClaw Scanner
shortDescription: Discover OpenClaw gateway services on a network by scanning specified IP addresses or ranges via HTTP and mDNS probes.

rawRecord.name: OpenClaw Scanner
rawRecord.short_description: Discover OpenClaw gateway services on a network by scanning specified IP addresses or ranges via HTTP and mDNS probes.
rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: OpenClaw Scanner is a local MCP server that discovers OpenClaw services on a network. It probes target IP addresses or CIDR ranges using HTTP detection on port 18789 and mDNS PTR queries on port 5353, returning structured results including host metadata, protocol details, and match evidence. Supports individual IPs, CIDR notation, and IP ranges up to 4,096 addresses per scan.
